title: SeeGULL Multilingual: a Dataset of Geo-Culturally Situated Stereotypes

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating foundation models' endorsement of stereotypes associated with national and local regional identities (demonyms) using a multiple-choice stereotype association task.
Comparing how stereotype prevalence, endorsement by language models, and perceived offensiveness vary across 20 languages and 23 geographic regions using culturally situated human annotations.

Analyzing differences in stereotypical attributes (e.g., appearance vs. bravery) associated with masculine versus feminine forms of gendered demonyms in languages such as Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, and Dutch.
